notes: §2002:14.8.13.3 GR2 (§2014:14.9.13.3 GR2 the same): an EXIT PROGRAM executed within the range of a USE GLOBAL declarative of the same program (a non-GLOBAL declarative section the GLOBAL declarative PERFORMs) sets EC-FLOW-GLOBAL-EXIT, Fatal, by the same run-time __useActive test as EC-FLOW-GLOBAL-GOBACK; with checking on its USE procedure runs (§2002:14.5.12.1.2 item 2). The EXIT FUNCTION format is bound as the GOBACK it equals and shares the arm; the EXIT METHOD arm is unreachable until a method may carry declaratives. From 2023 no rule sets the condition (docs/conformance/3/D-GLOBAL-EXIT.md, VCR row 7.118). The golden matched at --std 2002 and 2014.
